environmentAnchors: YG Entertainment describes Pink Venom as a 2022 hip-hop pre-release built from intense beats and Korean traditional instrument sounds, grounding a dark instrument chamber joined to a modern performance lane.

YG's official profile establishes a four-member group, while the project deliberately condenses the runtime lead into one anonymous Unit Thread Echo so no member identity or extra character enters the pose atlases.

The official Pink Venom video is the primary visual evidence for a Korean zither-like performance chamber, black-pink urban sets and high-contrast magenta stage light; exact instruments, rooms, wardrobes and formations are excluded.

Temple chamber, street catwalk, instrument, light gates, microphone and every effect are original project-locked recompositions; no official set, member, dancer, costume, instrument model, frame, logo, text or choreography is copied.

leadVisualAnchors.detail: One anonymous adult unit-representative stage lead with confident upright dance posture, compact microphone line, asymmetrical jacket silhouette and entirely invented face, hair, skin, body, build and proportions.

Original black urban performance jacket with venom-pink asymmetrical panel, charcoal fitted trousers, restrained gold belt hardware and plain black boots; no member wardrobe, hairstyle, jewelry or screen costume is replicated.
One generic unbranded handheld microphone with fixed matte-black body and pink ring in all eight pose frames; no weapon, zither, fan, prop swap, readable mark or second character.
Matte-black and charcoal costume masses, venom-pink panel, restrained gold hardware, electric-violet rim light and cold-white stage highlights.

limitations: Official sources establish Pink Venom's release, Korean traditional sound, four-member performance context and primary temple-street evidence; the joined gameplay route is wholly original.

Blackpink Unit is always one identity-safe Thread Echo; no Jisoo, Jennie, Rose, Lisa or dancer face, hair, skin, body, exact wardrobe, jewelry, instrument, photograph, video frame, logo, text or choreography is reproduced.
